shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "find app -maxdepth 5 -type f -print | sort && git status --short && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' lib/data.ts && cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' app/product/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && cat next.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && git diff -- package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"loading\\.tsx|Suspense|cacheComponents|connection\\(|Premium Widget|ProductPage\" . -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__'"' && git log --oneline -5 --all && git show HEAD:package.json && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json && find .next/server/app/product -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort && rg -n \"Premium Widget|Loading inventory\" .next/server/app/product -g '*'"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next/server/app -type f \\( -name '*product*' -o -path '*/product/*' \\) -print | sort | sed -n '1,200p' && find .next -type f \\( -name '*.html' -o -name '*.rsc' -o -name '*.prefetch.rsc' \\) -print | sort | sed -n '1,200p' && rg -a -l \"Premium Widget\" .next/server | sed -n '1,80p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .next/server/app/product.html && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > /tmp/original-tsconfig.txt && diff -u /tmp/original-tsconfig.txt tsconfig.json || true && cat .gitignore"

/bin/bash -lc 'cleanup_dir=$(mktemp -d)
mv /workspace/.next "$cleanup_dir/.next"
mv /workspace/next-env.d.ts "$cleanup_dir/next-env.d.ts"
git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- app/product/page.tsx
git diff --quiet -- tsconfig.json'
